name: The Hand of Rastakhan

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: The trail ends on Yojamba Isle, where the seeker is directed to Molthor and asked to bring aid against Hakkar. The quest handoff points toward a later Zul'Gurub campaign; it does not include the raid's outcome. Here the Ancient Egg story stops at the request, with the physical summoning of Hakkar held for its own evidence and its own telling.
